title: File:Union Glacier Headquarters.jpg
claims: Blue and white camp buildings on flat snow at Union Glacier, with tracked-vehicle trails leading away and low mountains on the horizon; no start arch, finish tape or race furniture appears. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.
